label: D2C skincare
brief: A premium skincare brand selling a small range of clinically-backed serums direct to consumers. Our customers are in their 30s and 40s, have tried a lot of products that did not work, and are sceptical of marketing claims. Every ingredient is disclosed with its concentration. We want first-time visitors to buy the starter set.
